build_get_default_optimizer_param_groups: build optimizer param groups from a model with trunk, head, and remaining parameters separated by regularization
test_get_default_optimizer_param_groups: test the get_default_optimizer_param_groups function with a model, config, and optimizer schedulers
refactor_get_norm_optimizer_params: refactor _get_norm_optimizer_params to separate BN layer weights into regularized and unregularized lists
review_assign_regularized_params: review _assign_regularized_params to remove specified parameters from regularized lists and move them to unregularized
summarize_filter_trainable: summarize _filter_trainable which filters a parameter list to keep only parameters with requires_grad set to True
